how_adapted: Acquired via browser (Raw view copy/paste). Converted from prototype methods on TokenStream to standalone functions (expr, start) returning {value,end}; accept uppercase X/B prefixes; guard exponent parsing so '2e' lexes as 2 followed by name e (implicit multiplication). The parser, evaluator, built-ins, calculator state and REPL were written new because expr-eval's grammar (precedence, implicit multiplication, error positions) does not match the spec.
